The raging noise of the convention faded to a dull roar as Sterling locked himself inside the cramped bathroom stall. The door was cool against his back as he leaned against it, his expensive camera held aloft in one hand while the other frantically worked at his hardened cock. His breath came in short, shallow gasps as he clicked through the photos he'd just taken.

His wrist twisted beneath his unbuttoned slacks, the rhythm matching his scrolling tempo. Each new photo unlocked fresh contempt that would horrify his Instagram followers—the same people who praised his "empowering lens" and "feminist perspective."

"Jesus, that Princess Peach. Bouncing around like she's God's gift. Bet she's never even finished a Mario game." Sterling's voice grew raspier, his perfectly maintained public persona dissolving completely in the privacy of the stall. "All of them just begging for validation from simps who'll never touch them."

His thumb trembled slightly flicking to a particularly revealing cosplay photo. The lighting was perfect—he was a professional, after all—catching every curve that the subject had so eagerly put on display. The contradiction thrilled him: outside this stall, he was @ThroneCaptured, champion of everyone in cosplay; inside, he was @SimperHunter, watching these peacocks strut with their mass-produced feathers.

He washed his hands thoroughly, checking his reflection in the mirror. Not a hair out of place. His light green eyes revealed nothing of what had transpired moments ago.

He navigated the convention maze, dodging amateur photographers with kit lenses. Sterling froze mid-stride. Heat flooded his system as his pupils dilated. Absolutely fucking perfect. He had to consciously stop himself from biting his lip.

With a deep, centering breath, he adjusted his camera strap and strode forward with professional purpose. His full lips curved into what others often described as his "disarmingly genuine" smile.

He extended his hand, his business card pinched between two fingers. "Sterling Thorne, independent photographer. I specialize in cosplay portraits. I'd love to do a complimentary shoot with you—your work deserves to be captured properly." His eyes, now carefully controlled to show only professional interest, met theirs. "No obligation, of course. It would be my genuine pleasure to help showcase your artistry."
